recipes.name: Spiedini alla Romana
ingredients: fry oil of choice, as needed
2 tbsp fresh parsley, chopped, plus more for garnish
instructions: Assemble the sandwiches by placing 2-3 slices of mozzarella between two slices of bread. Set aside until ready to use. - 4 slices crusty bread (Italian loaf) - 8 oz fresh mozzarella cheese sliced

Preheat about ½ inch of fry oil to 350 °F in a medium high-walled skillet. Add the capers and fry for 1-2 minutes or until crispy and popped. Using a slotted spoon, remove the capers from the oil and set aside on a paper towel-lined plate. - fry oil of choice as needed - ⅓ cup capers drained & dried

Prepare the sauce in a separate large saucepan. Melt the butter in the saucepan over medium heat. Add the shallot and cook until translucent, about 1 minute. - 1 tbsp unsalted butter - 1 shallot minced
Add the garlic cloves and anchovies to the skillet, and cook until the anchovies have mostly melted into a sauce, about 2-3 minutes. - 2 garlic cloves smashed - 2 anchovy filets

Deglaze the pan with white wine, then cook for 1 minute longer or until the alcohol smell has burned off. Then, add the chicken stock and tomato puree. Bring the sauce to a simmer and cook until thickened, about 8-10 minutes. - ¼ cup dry white wine - ¾ cup chicken stock - 1 cup tomato puree

Stir in the lemon juice, oregano, red pepper flakes, and parsley. Season the sauce to taste with salt and pepper. Keep warm until ready to serve. - 1 (2 tbsp) lemon juiced - ¼ tsp dried oregano - ¼ tsp crushed red pepper flakes - 2 tbsp fresh parsley chopped, plus more for garnish - kosher salt to taste - freshly ground pepper to taste

Heat the cooking olive oil in a medium skillet over medium-high heat. Add the prepared sandwiches to the preheated oil and cook until golden brown, about 2-3 minutes per side. - 2 tbsp cooking olive oil - 4 slices crusty bread (Italian loaf)

Serve the sandwiches with a generous amount of the reserved tomato sauce. Garnish with more parsley, a lemon wedge, and the crispy fried capers. - 1 cup tomato puree - 2 tbsp fresh parsley chopped, plus more for garnish - 1 lemon for garnish - ⅓ cup capers drained & dried
